title: Yu-Gi-Oh TCG Bubonic Vermin Pharaoh's Servant PSV-057 1st Edition Common Card LP
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card features the Bubonic Vermin character, a beast-type creature/monster that is perfect for collectors and players alike. The card is part of the Pharaoh's Servant set and is a 1st Edition Common card, with a card number of PSV-057. It was manufactured by Konami in the United States in 2002 and is made from high-quality card stock material.

The card is in excellent shape and has been well-preserved, making it an ideal addition to any collection. It is a Standard size card and has a regular finish. The card is in English language and is suitable for ages 6 and up. This vintage card is sure to be a valuable addition to any Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG collection.
